productOutcomes: Install one inert default-deny Vercel Preview deployment controller and mutation firewall

invalidatedBy: any controller, gateway, provider route/state, identity, target, alias, environment, receipt, test, or writer changes
implementation PR base, head, changed paths, required check, review, or actionable feedback changes
merge SHA, protected main, post-merge required health, CD containment, cleanup, or closeout identity changes
success-closeout containment or exact-main health failure
any failure-closeout, exact revert, executed CD step, incident state, or successor promotion after failure

acceptanceMatrix.command: run the directly collected controller and mutation-firewall suites plus syntax, formatting, modularity, secret-pattern, and deterministic repo-size checks
acceptanceMatrix.expected: every canonical request/state, hostile route, direct-egress or extra-read attempt, hidden cert/domain recovery, alias/Production inventory, target derivation, closed environment, cleanup, and one-shot adversary passes with no skips

acceptanceMatrix.command: observe one exact-head GitHub-hosted required-check and terminal-feedback rollup
acceptanceMatrix.expected: all required current-head checks pass, workflow/provider/runtime remains absent, and actionable or unresolved feedback is zero

acceptanceMatrix.command: merge only the exact reviewed head, contain only its exact automatic CD before executable steps, and verify exact-main health and preauthorized closeout
acceptanceMatrix.expected: protected main equals the exact merge, health is green, CD has no runner or executed step, only exact refs are cleaned, and the closeout promotes only measurement integration; any adverse implementation/transition/containment/main-health result uses only the blocked failure closeout and cannot satisfy this success criterion

edges.operation: consume exact project, lock, archive, and identity contracts
route every bounded provider observation and the one future fixed CLI process through default-deny read/mutation state
prove identity, environment, observation, receipt, and cleanup
prove canonical routes and reject hidden/duplicate/provider mutations
prove this inert slice cannot change score, gzip, or first-request TTFB thresholds

closureEvidence.callers: future protected-main workflow is the only named production caller
closureEvidence.sharedConsumers: one future R2 consumes the controller/firewall
closureEvidence.readWriteDelete: all provider reads and the CLI traverse one loopback; direct egress, extra reads, child/temp state, sanitized receipt, and exact-ref lifecycle are explicit
closureEvidence.mountErrorPaths: port, TLS, redirect, response, child, poll, alias, target, and cleanup failures stop closed
closureEvidence.capabilityRequirements: exact existing Vercel project/team and one future environment-bound token stage are explicit but unused here
closureEvidence.testCollectors: both new tests are directly collected under scripts/ci/*.test.mjs
closureEvidence.baselineOwnership: this slice owns confinement/identity only; OD17 thresholds remain parent-owned

highestRiskCases: the CLI reaches a domain, certificate, project, alias, environment, promotion, or deletion mutation
a second deployment create or undeclared upload is forwarded
a controller observation or CLI request bypasses the firewall or adds an undeclared GET
alias pagination or Production pointer comparison truncates or accepts drift
missing target is treated as Preview or a nonexistent production boolean is trusted
a secret, proxy, inherited Vercel ID, plugin, telemetry, update, or raw CLI stream escapes the closed child environment
provider access occurs during this inert slice
a post-merge failure leaves runtime_authorized true or a successor promoted
a runner assignment or executed CD step is mislabeled as zero provider state
a failure closeout, exact revert, or successor action exceeds its one-shot ceiling

rollback.mechanism: delete only an unmerged exact branch; use at most one separately reviewed mechanical exact-revert PR only while the implementation merge is the most recent merge touching its writer paths and only as temporary containment; once a success transition merges, removal of either merge requires separate incident/revert authority after the mandatory child-specific failure-closeout PR; that closeout sets runtime_authorized false, activeSlice null, and all successors blocked, and inability to merge it stops for blocked current-authority incident repair without retry
rollback.trigger: any unauthorized writer, contract ambiguity, line breach, test skip, current-head finding, required-check failure, merge/main regression, CD-containment failure, cleanup failure, or successor promotion without the full success chain
rollback.containmentFailure: if any CD runner or step executes, preserve exact evidence, mark provider/runtime state unknown, merge only the deauthorizing failure closeout when safe, and stop for separate incident authority

firstImplementationAction: add the directly collected RED mutation-firewall attack matrix and controller identity/environment contract before any production helper is written

failurePolicy.exactRevertScope: implementation merge only while it is the most recent merge touching its writer paths and its success transition has not merged, as temporary containment before mandatory failure closeout
failurePolicy.failedChildDefinition: the child whose active implementation/governance attempt, implementation PR or merge, or success-transition PR or merge is the failing or invalidated stage; after promotion attribution remains with that predecessor and never shifts to the successor
failurePolicy.mergedSuccessCloseoutDisposition: the failure closeout names the exact success-closeout path and merge SHA and marks it superseded and non-promoting without editing it
failurePolicy.executedCdStep: record containment_failure, preserve evidence, provider state unknown, stop for incident authority
